$interactive_namespace_note: OPEN QUESTION (Navigations search flyout): a LIVE 'interactive/on-light/*' namespace exists in Figma (surface/primary/default, border/active/default #000, surface/brand-1/default #db0011 +disabled) — the un-suffixed mirror of 'interactive (depricate)/on-light/*' and the apparent 1:1 migration target. BUT it is NOT in the canonical variable export/store, so it may be Sutherland-mode or an uncaptured collection. PREFERRED PATH (if confirmed canon): drop the ' (depricate)' suffix — interactive (depricate)/on-light/X -> interactive/on-light/X. FALLBACK PATH (if NOT canon / Sutherland leak): rebind to the already-in-store semantics by context, all proven across Dropdown/Input/List/Nav/Modals: surface/primary/default|hover|pressed|disabled -> background/default (nav+modal surfaces) | form/background/default|hover|pressed (form fields) | tertiary/background/default|hover|pressed|disabled (list rows); border/active/default -> form/border/active; border/high-contrast/default -> form/border/default; border/low-contrast/disabled -> form/border/disabled; surface/brand-1/default -> primary/background/default; border/brand-1/default -> primary/border/default | color/primary. So even without the un-suffixed namespace, every interactive(depricate) token already has an in-store target — the namespace swap would just be tidier, not required.
